response.sql: WITH total_count AS (SELECT COUNT(*) as total_awards FROM manager_award), player_awards AS (SELECT player_id, COUNT(*) as award_count FROM manager_award GROUP BY player_id) SELECT pa.player_id, pa.award_count, CAST(pa.award_count AS NUMERIC) / CAST(tc.total_awards AS NUMERIC) as fraction FROM player_awards pa CROSS JOIN total_count tc WHERE tc.total_awards > 0 ORDER BY fraction DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
